job.parent.meaning: a Job is composed under a parent Job

job.input.meaning: a Job observes identified input Resources

job.output.meaning: a Job produces or changes identified Resources

job.actor.meaning: an Actor is attributable for performing/participating in a Job

job.environment.meaning: a Job execution receives an admitted Environment

environment.actor.meaning: Environment grants are issued to one attributable Actor context

environment.resource.meaning: an Environment grants bounded operations over Resources

job.definition.meaning: a Job binds an exact revision of its outcome contract; a registry indexes these Resources without granting execution authority
